name: BLESS
description: BLESS is a comprehensive benchmark evaluating large language models on the task of text simplification across multiple domains including Wikipedia, news, and medical texts, assessing model performance under few-shot settings with various automatic and qualitative metrics.
reputation: A recent text simplification benchmark that is gaining attention in the NLP community but is not yet a widely established standard.
notes: Evaluates 44 LLMs on three test sets from different domains; includes both automatic and manual qualitative analyses.
